# Night 30 Briefing (Morning)

## 1️⃣ High‑Priority Items  
| Item | Status | Deadline | Action |
|------|--------|----------|--------|
| **Camera‑ready for Submission 4127** | 10 % written, 5 % figures | **Day +14** | Draft final manuscript ps 2–3 day slots. *Draft: "Re: Camera‑ready – outline remaining sections."* |
| **Rewrite‑vs‑Append Ablation (Issue #214)** | Runs queued, 2 runs stuck at 30 items | **Day +5** | Trigger full sweep up to 60 items, log accuracy curves. *Draft: "Ablation sweep: settings… will finish by tomorrow, results ready for paper."* |
| **Workshop Paper with Maya** | Proposal drafted | **Day +7** | Email Maya: invite to discuss outline, target venue, assign sections. *Draft: "Hi Maya… Let’s meet Thursday 14:00 in lab 311 to sync on workshop paper."* |
| **Weekly Lab Meeting** | – | **Today, 11 :00** | Prepare slide on consolidation results (Fig. 3). |

## 2️⃣ Actionable Drafts  

| Task | Draft |
|------|-------|
| **Camera‑ready section on consolidation** | “Section 4.2 – Consolidation and interference. We implemented the periodic summarization described in *Consolidation reduces cross‑fact interference* (ref 45562236). The baseline now attains 78 % recall at 80 items, matching the bounded‑memory variant.” |
| **Email to co‑author Maya (Workshop)** | “Hi Maya, I’ve sketched a 1‑page outline for the agent‑memory benchmark paper. I’d love to sync on Thu 14:00 (lab 311) to nail scope and data requirements. Let me know if that works.” |
| **Internal memo: Ablation results** | “Ablation run 3/3 completed: rewrite‑vs‑append gap grows from 2 % at 20 items to 9 % at 60 items, confirming interference is mitigated by rewrite.” |

## 3️⃣ Overnight Idea  
**Integrate MemGPT‑style paging with periodic consolidation** – paging older facts to external memory while summarizing the recent window into an in‑context compact buffer. This hybrid should (i) raise the effective capacity past the ~40‑item drop, and (ii) satisfy Reviewer 2’s rewrite‑vs‑append comparison by providing a *naïve‑append* baseline with equivalent consolidation. Run a quick prototype alongside the ablation sweep.
